Place your project images and profile photo here.

Expected filenames (referenced in src/data/projects.ts and src/pages/About.tsx):

- excellence-score.png
- salary-advance.png
- adjustment-tool.png
- flo-profil.jpg

You can rename these freely — just update the corresponding src= paths
in src/data/projects.ts and src/pages/About.tsx.

Tip: in dev, you can temporarily reuse the URLs from your old WordPress
site (e.g. https://florent-martinez.com/wp-content/uploads/...) so you
have something on screen while you migrate the assets.
